falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern featured a sharp V-recovery with no retest; a break below 4,800 would violate the structural support level established in that pattern, invalidating the 81% similarity match and suggesting a distribution phase rather than accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom saw VIX spike above 20 then rapidly collapse; sustained elevated volatility above 25 indicates ongoing panic rather than the panic-washout-and-reverse signature required for a valid bottom pattern match

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield breaks above 4.50% and holds above it for 2 consecutive closes
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom coincided with yields peaking and reversing lower; a sustained break above 4.50% would signal a renewed growth scare or inflation repricing, destroying the disinflationary relief narrative that enabled the prior bottom's recovery
